Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavya - 12 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Meenakshi - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Ajay - 45 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Meenakshi, Ajay and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Nikhil (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil plays cricket in the park.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "I knew it!"

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Kavya (laughing): "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Ajay stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Ajay, look over here."

[Nikhil runs to Mother.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

[Nikhil thinks for a moment.]

Meenakshi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil stamps his foot in anger.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "One more time!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Ajay: "Hmm, I see."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Ajay (happily): "Let's see."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Kavya stands in the living room. Nikhil, Meenakshi and Ajay stand near her.]

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[Kavya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Ajay: "I knew it!"

[Nikhil eats his breakfast at the table.]

Ajay: "Well done!"

[Nikhil does his homework at the table.]

Nikhil (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
